terms.EDP data-plane service: The Go edpsvc process exposing admin/data-plane HTTP routes.
terms.backlog authority: The PostgreSQL backlog_id_allocations global row and its reservation counter.
terms.tenant scoped: A query executed with store.BindTenant setting app.tenant_id for forced RLS.
terms.runtime proof: A test or command that exercises the production entrypoint, adapter, and data store, not a helper or fake.
terms.ACTIONED: A review finding with a concrete code/test/doc/evidence reference; never prose alone.
terms.MATERIAL_CHANGE: An explicit HIL-approved exception allowing a post-review material change or re-review.
terms.full-candidate review: A review of the complete candidate diff, not only a delta since the previous review.
